
name: facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/i.create_VideoReader: create a VideoReader instance to open a video file and access frames by index or iteration
facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/i.read_frames_with_VideoReader: read frames sequentially from a video using VideoReader read method with built-in caching support

facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/o.warp_image_with_flow: warp an image using optical flow with nearest or bilinear interpolation via flow_warp
facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/o.parse_sparse_flow_from_bytes: parse KITTI sparse optical flow from raw bytes and return flow array with validity mask

facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/p.resize_video_by_size: resize a video to a specific width and height using ffmpeg scale filter
facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/p.resize_video_by_ratio: resize a video by a scaling ratio while optionally keeping the original aspect ratio
facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/p.cut_video_clip: cut a clip from a video between a start and end time in seconds
facebookresearch_sapiens/cv/mmcv/video/p.concat_video_list: concatenate multiple video files into a single output video using ffmpeg concat demuxer
